description_en: Calls the DescribeSiteMonitorQuota operation to query the quota and version of site monitoring
description_zh: 调用DescribeSiteMonitorQuota接口查询站点监控的配额以及版本
name: DescribeSiteMonitorQuota

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

The value 200 indicates that the request was successful

SecondMonitor.description_en:
Indicates whether second-level monitoring is enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
SecondMonitor.description_zh:
是否开启秒级监控。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭

SiteMonitorIdcQuota.description_en: The quota of Alibaba detection points. The free quota is 5
SiteMonitorIdcQuota.description_zh: 阿里巴巴探测点配额。免费配额5个

SiteMonitorOperatorQuotaQuota.description_en: The quota of non-Alibaba detection points. Default value: 0
SiteMonitorOperatorQuotaQuota.description_zh: 非阿里巴巴探测点配额。默认值：0

SiteMonitorQuotaTaskUsed.description_en: The number of used site monitoring detection task quotas
SiteMonitorQuotaTaskUsed.description_zh: 站点监控探测任务配额使用数

SiteMonitorTaskQuota.description_en: The quota of site monitoring detection tasks
SiteMonitorTaskQuota.description_zh: 站点监控探测任务配额

SiteMonitorVersion.description_en:
The version of site monitoring. Valid values:

V1: the old version.
 
V2: the new version
SiteMonitorVersion.description_zh:
站点监控版本。取值：

V1：老版本。
 
V2：新版本

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
